body: Ran IDFC Premier Equity from Oct 2005 to Sept 2015 (earlier Kotak Mahindra AMC); a FLAME University bio cites ~22.3% CAGR over ten years for the flagship (promotional, unverified end date). The fund became so popular that inflows were restricted (characterisation); after his 2015 exit it struggled. Founded Old Bridge Capital in 2015 (PMS, ~Rs 8,000 crore AUM per a Mint interview); launched the Old Bridge Focused Equity MF in Jan 2024. Process edge: supply-side, capital-cycle analysis - buy into industries where capacity additions have stopped, weak players are exiting and the survivors ('last man standing') gain pricing power; favour high asset-turnover, capital-light businesses; go where earnings are depressed and nobody is looking. Mistakes: his contrarian, commodity/cyclical-leaning PMS lagged in 2016-2020 when quality-growth dominated (characterisation; check data); the mid-cap-heavy IDFC fund suffered as it grew large. Copyable: track industry capex and capacity utilisation (cement, paper, sugar, chemicals) - consolidation plus no new capacity is an early signal that tends to precede margin recovery by 1-2 years; avoid sectors where everyone is announcing capacity.

title: Kenneth Andrade - supply-side contrarian, 'last man standing' (India)
